sensor: correlated: rho .05, q matched to e .14

tuning.order: val positions 0..9 of the manifest, building-major
tuning.objective: mean over complete buildings of the mean over the 8 cells of the per-episode mean decision loss
tuning.stop_rule: a building starts only if the projected wall and CPU time fit; selection on complete buildings only
tuning.selection: per method the lowest configuration; H2 control = control method with the lowest tuned loss; ties: lower mean sent bytes, then id

test.prefix_rule: B = max(60, ceil((2 * 1.96 * sd_delta / 0.05)^2)), sd_delta from a calib-split pilot (E08-T01), capped by the approved batch budget; first B entries of each test list; if the budget does not allow 60 the result is 'inconclusive by design', never topped up afterwards
test.methods: candidate and every control with its validation-selected configuration
test.replacement: an invalid scenario is replaced by the next unused entry of the same list and family; logged

estimands.primary_h2: gain = 1 - mean_b L_repair / mean_b L_control over id_test buildings, cells weighted equally, families stratified 50/50, L = mean decision loss per request
estimands.h1: per building I = L11 - L10 - L01 + L00 for each factor pair, averaged over the third factor
estimands.ood: same estimands on ood_test per family, reported separately

inference.bootstrap: paired cluster bootstrap, 10000 replicates, percentile 2.5/97.5, stratified by family
inference.multiplicity: Holm for secondary p-values; bootstrap CIs not called adjusted

claims.h2: lower CI bound of the gain >= 0.10 and upper CI bound of the relative coverage loss <= 0.05 under equal resource limits; otherwise not supported
claims.zero_control_loss: relative gain undefined; absolute difference reported

failure_rules.timeout_or_error: kept as failure; its decision loss from the failure tick on is that of the default decision 'closed'; reported per method
failure_rules.sensitivity: pairs with any failed episode excluded

sensitivity.note: rho .1 at 4:1 is a near-threshold regime and is reported, not hidden

novelty: pending until full texts [A:20,21] are checked and delimited from [A:24]
deviations: only via change request; recorded as deviation in the gate report
